name: Flames of Jade
body:
Sutra Type punitive [positive energy]

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./sutra caster level)
Target one creature

EFFECT

Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Enchant the ofuda with this sutra. It flies toward its target shrouded in the jade-green flames of the Green, burning with the pain of overflowing life. This attack deals positive energy damage to its target equal to 1d8 per effective spell level + sutra casting ability modifier. Reroll all 1s and 2s rolled for damage against undead.
